name: product-demand-research
title_zh: 从 Reddit 评论里挖出用户原话的产品需求调研员
tagline_zh: 产品想法没人验证？别拍脑袋。它去 Reddit、社媒、视频评论区捞真实吐槽和反对声，带回带证据的需求报告。
tagline_en: Validate ideas with real user voices from Reddit, social posts & video comments. Get evidence-backed demand.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to validate a product idea, find pain points, mine demand signals, discover objections, or gather voice-of-customer language from Reddit, social posts, video transcripts, and comments. Produces evidence-backed product research.
why_zh: 不是泛泛舆情分析，而是定向挖需求信号：能区分痛点、反对理由、用户原话，并标注来源证据，让结论可追溯。
why_en: Goes beyond generic sentiment: it mines structured demand signals—pain points, objections, verbatim quotes—each traced to a.
limit_zh: 只做公开文本的定性调研，不跑问卷、不算样本量、不预测市场规模。依赖 Reddit 等平台可访问性。
limit_en: Qualitative research on public text only—no surveys, no stats, no market sizing. Output depends on platform access; blocked or sparse sources yield.
title_en: Mine product demand from Reddit & comments
